question: Is salvia addictive?

trials.note: with room to reason and write

draft.text: Not known to be addictive. FRANK and Australia's Alcohol and Drug Foundation both say salvia is not known to cause physical or psychological dependence.
The long-term effects of salvia have not been studied enough to understand what the risks might be.
FRANK says salvia is not known to be physically addictive or to cause psychological dependence. It also says it is not known to be addictive.

Australia's Alcohol and Drug Foundation says salvia is not known to cause physical or psychological dependence or tolerance. It notes that most people choose not to use it regularly because its effects can be very intense.
